message: Todo 01a19411-2106 (vg-paradigms' graft 01a19407-84f6): tend's hook dispatcher is built (tend / Core / Checks, done: `tend code hook --dispatcher <dir>` writes the hooks; the machine's dotfiles point git's core.hooksPath at the folder). Every Nix machine's git now points there, and this repo's commit test is nix/scripts/check.sh, declared once for Linux and once for Windows (through WSL).; What the checks showed in this worktree: two Nix checks passed without evaluating anything, now made to fail; the Nix side of this todo is unverified until it's run from the main checkout. (proposal 01a1e321-efcc-7242-8fa0-0f1d544fd76a, proposed by agent:hub-worker from a hub worker, accepted by user)

text: git with the user's identity, delta as its pager, tend's hook dispatcher for every repo (git's global core.hooksPath), and the GitHub CLI.

Every Nix machine's git runs tend's hook dispatcher: global core.hooksPath is ~/.config/git/hooks (common.git.tendHooks, on by default, `dir` to move it), and the user writes the dispatcher there once per machine with `tend code hook --dispatcher ~/.config/git/hooks`; until then each switch warns that no hook runs
why: vg-paradigms asked for it (graft 01a19407-84f6): with CI off, hooks on every clone are the only automatic check. tend's answer (graft 01a19407-a869, tend / Core / Checks): `tend code hook --dispatcher <dir>` writes the hooks into a folder, each running the repo's own .git/hooks/<event> and then tend's where there's a .tend/, and the machine's dotfiles point git at it. tend has no Nix package and where it's installed on each Nix host isn't known here (home-manager's activation starts with an empty PATH), so nix doesn't write the hooks or copy them: it sets the path, and the activation step only says when the folder is still empty, since with core.hooksPath set git reads no repo's own .git/hooks. Installing hooks is the user's (the conduct), as tend's ADOPTING says: once per machine. Checked by profiles.test.sh on vgsquid-jade (both profiles get it in their generated git config; with the switch off for one user, that user's config has no hooksPath and no warning).

check.name: check
check.notes: The repo's whole check before a commit (no CI): every host evaluates, vgwsl2's home layer builds, the profiles and exports tests, shellcheck, the bootstrap, wallpaper, dot and template tests, and the guest isolation VM test where there's /dev/kvm (said to be skipped otherwise). Run by tend's pre-commit through the hook dispatcher on any Linux machine with Nix; on Windows the same script is check-wsl. Its steps that are also declared on their own nodes run again there.

check.name: check-wsl
check.notes: `check` on Windows: the same script in the NixOS-WSL distro (vgwsl2), where nix is; plain `bash` on Windows isn't WSL's and has no coreutils.

check.name: check-hosts
check.notes: Evaluates every nixosConfigurations / darwinConfigurations toplevel and every homeConfigurations activationPackage (drvPath only, nothing is built). NixOS hosts without hardware-configuration.nix in git report PENDING and don't fail. On Windows only: on Linux it's the first step of `check` (no `wsl` there). Verified 2026-10-09: all ok or pending (exit 0); a control copy with an undefined option on vgwsl2 failed with the option's error (exit 1).

check.name: templates
check.notes: Per template, in a throwaway git repo: nix flake init, lock, `nix flake check -L` passes, the dev shell has its tool, the built program prints Hello, world!; control: with its test's expected greeting changed, the check fails and its log shows that expectation. On Windows only: on Linux it's a step of `check` (no `wsl` there).

check.name: exports
check.notes: Linux only (plain bash on Windows has no coreutils or nix; there it runs inside check-wsl).

check.name: bootstrap-tests
check.notes: Linux only (plain bash on Windows has no coreutils; there it runs inside check-wsl).

text: Checks declared per OS: check.sh is the commit test, run with bash on Linux and through WSL on Windows
why: With the dispatcher, tend's pre-commit runs this repo's tests on whatever machine commits. The tests were declared half with `wsl -d NixOS --` (check-hosts, templates), which can't run on Linux (no wsl: they'd fail every commit on vgwsl2 or a NixOS host), and half with plain `bash` (exports, bootstrap-tests), which fail on vghydra: its bash isn't WSL's and has no coreutils (impl_score run, 2026-11-16: `dirname: command not found`, `grep: command not found`). So each says where it runs (needs os:windows or os:linux), and check.sh, which runs every step, is `check` on Linux and `check-wsl` on Windows. Steps declared on their own nodes run once more beside it on the OS they're for (check-hosts and templates on Windows, exports and bootstrap-tests on Linux).

title: check-hosts and the templates test passed without evaluating anything when the flake didn't load
body: From a hub worker's worktree on Windows, WSL's nix can't open the repo (its .git names a Windows gitdir), so listing the hosts and the templates failed; both scripts threw that error away (2>/dev/null, an empty `read`), looped over nothing and exited 0. Shown by a control on 2026-11-16: with home/modules/git deliberately broken, check-hosts still passed in 11 s and templates in 0.3 s. Fixed: check-hosts.sh fails each output that lists no configurations, with nix's error, and templates.test.sh fails when no template is listed; rerun, both now fail there with `failed to resolve path 'C:/vg-dotfiles/.git/worktrees/...'`. Lesson: a check that loops over what it discovers fails when it discovers nothing; try it with a broken input before trusting its pass.

title: No Nix check runs in a hub worker's worktree on Windows
body: WSL's git and nix can't resolve the worktree's Windows gitdir, so check-hosts, templates and check-wsl can't evaluate anything there; the plain-bash tests (exports, bootstrap-tests) fail on Windows anyway. The tendHooks change (home/modules/git, profiles.test.sh's new checks, the check-hosts and templates guards) is therefore unverified until check.sh runs from C:\vg-dotfiles or on a Linux machine. Asked tend for relative worktree paths (graft 01a1e321-3c8e).

title: Verify the tend hook dispatcher change, then finish its todo and answer vg-paradigms' graft 01a19407-84f6
body: After merging hub/hookspath-91bc4b57c739 and accepting its proposal: from C:\vg-dotfiles run `wsl -d NixOS -- bash nix/scripts/check.sh` (or `tend code checks --run`, which runs it as check-wsl). Every host must evaluate, and profiles.test.sh's two new checks pass: every user's git config has hooksPath = ~/.config/git/hooks, and with tendHooks off for one user that user has none. Then on each Nix machine, switch and run `tend code hook --dispatcher ~/.config/git/hooks` once. Then mark todo 01a19411-2106 done and answer graft 01a19407-84f6 done.
